channel.title: Redline — Terms of Service, Amended
channel.description: The terms of service changes companies didn't put in a headline. Filed twice monthly.

item.title: T-Mobile: Arbitration Opt-Out Removed (REDLINE-2026-007)
item.description: T-Mobile's Terms & Conditions effective September 1, 2026 removed the 30-day arbitration opt-out present in the version effective August 1, 2025, confirmed by direct word-for-word document comparison. Status: Verified.

item.title: Target: Liquid Glass App Redesign (AW-2026-001)
item.description: Target's iOS app adopted Apple's Liquid Glass design system on Aug 6, 2026 — likely OS-mandated compliance rather than a discretionary redesign. Status: Partially Verified. App Watch report.

item.title: DoorDash: Spotlight Replaces Homepage Banners (AW-2026-002)
item.description: DoorDash introduced "Spotlight," a large homepage ad format explicitly replacing prior banners, reporting 2x the click-through rate in early testing. Status: Partially Verified. App Watch report.

item.title: Adobe: Content License & AI Training Clarification (REDLINE-2026-002)
item.description: Adobe's June 2024 Terms of Use update sparked backlash over AI-training language; a revised version added an explicit no-training statement. Status: Verified.

item.title: Reddit: LLM Data Sharing Added to Privacy Policy (REDLINE-2026-004)
item.description: Reddit's May 2026 Privacy Policy revision added an LLM-provider sharing clause, with no notice found anywhere. Status: Partially Verified.

item.title: Starlink: AI Training Added, Opt-Out Default (REDLINE-2026-005)
item.description: Starlink's Jan 2026 Privacy Policy update added an opt-out AI-training clause, confirmed absent from a Reuters-reviewed Nov 2025 archive. Status: Partially Verified.

item.title: GitHub Copilot: AI Training Default Flip (REDLINE-2026-006)
item.description: Individual Copilot plans flipped from opt-in to opt-out AI training by default, effective Apr 24, 2026. Status: Verified.

item.title: Discord: Arbitration Clause Update (REDLINE-2026-003)
item.description: A May 2026 revision to Discord's arbitration clause was flagged by a third-party tracker; current terms confirmed directly, prior wording not yet diffed. Status: Partially Verified.

item.title: Google Ads: Arbitration, AI Inputs & Fees Overhaul (REDLINE-2026-001)
item.description: Google Ads' first Terms of Service overhaul since 2018 adds AI-input usage, arbitration, and pass-through fee provisions, effective Jul 1, 2026. Status: Verified.
